init_decoder_state_vanilla: init a decoder state for autoregressive generation with a given sequence length and batch start flags
call_transformer_layer_generate: run the transformer layer on input sequences with optional window state and decoder state for attention
next_decoder_state: compute the next decoder state and return keys and values to attend to during autoregressive decoding
update_slice_in_dim_1: update a stored keys or values slice for different-lengthed sequences in a batch using vmapped dynamic update
slice_in_dim_1: create a vmapped function that slices a window-length chunk from an array at a given index along axis 0
